name: Georgetown
seo_title: Georgetown Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Georgetown, CO: Christmas Market, Santa's Lighted Forest train, Idaho Springs Holiday Ramble and more.
lede: Georgetown is a Victorian mountain town that goes all in on Christmas, with a Dickens-style market, children's Santa Lucia procession and a lights train through the forest.
celebrates: Historic Georgetown, Inc. and the Town of Georgetown host the Georgetown Christmas Market on four days in December, with three outdoor European-style marketplaces, more than 30 artisans, horse and wagon rides, carolers and hot chestnuts. Just up the track, the Georgetown Loop Railroad runs Santa's Lighted Forest on winter evenings. Idaho Springs, a few miles east, folds into this page with its downtown Holiday Ramble.
lastyear: The 2026 market is the 66th annual Georgetown Christmas Market, which makes last year's the 65th. Historic Georgetown describes the market as set in a 19th century Victorian town with a Charles Dickens-style marketplace, and the group says Historic Georgetown was featured on NBC's Today Show as one of America's Merriest Main Streets. The Georgetown Loop's lighted train has become a Colorado holiday tradition.
facts: The Georgetown Christmas Market features the Santa Lucia Children's Procession each day at noon, escorted by Saint Nicholas. Georgetown Loop Railroad's Santa's Lighted Forest train uses more than 300,000 twinkling lights around the station and the forest beside the tracks, and the round trip lasts about 60 minutes. Both Hamill House and Alpine Hose museums open for the market.
trains: Georgetown is the best Christmas train town in the Denver area. The Georgetown Loop Railroad runs Santa's Lighted Forest, a 60-minute evening ride past more than 300,000 lights, from November 6 through December 24, 2026, and Santa joins every departure before Christmas. A daytime Santa's Rocky Mountain Adventure train is also described by Westword. The Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden is another stop.

faq: When is the Georgetown Christmas Market in 2026?

The 66th Annual Georgetown Christmas Market runs December 5 and 6 and December 12 and 13, 2026, in historic downtown Georgetown. Historic Georgetown lists admission, parking and shuttle as free, and the museums are open from 11 am to 3 pm on market days.
What is the Santa Lucia procession?

The Santa Lucia Children's Procession is a market tradition held each day at noon on the stage at Rose and 6th Streets, escorted by Saint Nicholas. Children take part in the procession as part of the outdoor entertainment, which runs from 11 am to 4 pm.
How long is the Santa's Lighted Forest train?

The round trip lasts approximately 60 minutes, and the Georgetown Loop Railroad says Santa joins every departure before Christmas. The season runs November 6 through December 24, 2026, and tickets are booked online. Prices for adults and children are on the event card.
Is Idaho Springs part of this page?

Yes. Idaho Springs is a small neighboring mountain town, so its downtown Holiday Ramble is carded here. Georgetown and Idaho Springs sit a short drive apart on Interstate 70, so many families visit both in one day.
